reason: My regulars come from the WhatsApp group and walking past the counter, not from Instagram. Good that there are no coupons, but I still have to connect Instagram, shoot clips during rush hour and approve posts, and I am not sure it brings anyone new through the door.
objection: Connecting my Instagram means logins and permissions I don't understand, and I don't believe a few reels will bring more customers than my WhatsApp offers already do.
would_change_my_mind: Another darshini owner near me telling me it actually brought new customers, and someone from the team setting up the Instagram connection on my phone in person.
